versions.changelog:
- Initial release of word-latex-formula: convert manually typed formulas in Word documents into editable Word equations.
- Supports .doc, .docx, and .wps formats using local Microsoft Word or LibreOffice automation.
- Preserves original document layout and modifies only OOXML formula targets for accuracy.
- Offers both one-step and staged (scan/review/apply) workflows for academic manuscripts or batch conversion.
- Optional AI-assisted formula classification with privacy controls and no document upload by default.
- Includes command-line interface and quick-launch Web UI for local use.
